details:
Repro steps and what happens:

1. Create a new account

2. Start the app and log in

3. After the birthday verification, the app shows the "Welcome!" dialog informing, "Before you enter the VRChat universe, we'll send you to a short tutorial to learn the basics."

4. Press the "Next" button to continue.

5. After the CAPTCHA test, the app goes to the "VRChat Home" world, not the "Tutorial" world.

Notes:

- I tested with a new Steam account with PC and a new Meta account with Quest2.

- I am unsure if this is a bug or intentional normal behavior. And it will happen to everyone or not. But I report here since it will be worth it.

- VRChat Home world https://vrchat.com/home/world/wrld_4432ea9b-729c-46e3-8eaf-846aa0a37fdd

- Tutorial world https://vrchat.com/home/world/wld_7d3d25ec-663e-406e-96a3-e2c4fc0d8104
